seed_ledger.name: ABI-1 Electric Generating Unit power plant (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: ONSITE_NO_PIPE: the TCEQ air permit notice (permit 182467, filed Dec 2025) says the plant serves a nearby data center and drops fuel gas pressure from 'the nearby pipeline', which describes an on-site tap on an existing line. VoltaGrid says Energy Transfer's pipeline network gives firm gas for all its Texas sites, and one aggregator names Oasis; no source names a lateral, route or length for this campus. The three Energy Transfer Abilene laterals in P8318 are tied by sources to the Oracle Abilene campus, not to this Shackelford County site. Argus and the Oracle fact sheet mention a Shackelford site only as a data center, not a lateral. Not reached: FERC dockets, Railroad Commission pipeline GIS, county records, Energy Transfer decks. Searches run: 7. Sources: TCEQ notice (tap on nearby pipeline), mgrid.org VoltaGrid article (Energy Transfer firm gas), Cleanview report (off grid, Energy Transfer supplier), Argus Media (900 MMcf/d Oracle supply, three sites), Baxtel listings (campus facts), Railroad Commission well-history hits (unrelated), Energy Transfer Q3 2026 release (not found).

evidence.note: TCEQ notice for air permit 182467: VoltaGrid ABI-1 plant serves a nearby data center; gas heaters warm fuel gas after pressure is dropped from the nearby pipeline
VoltaGrid article: Energy Transfer pipeline network gives firm gas for all Texas VoltaGrid sites
Cleanview report on the campus: behind the meter, off grid, Energy Transfer named as gas supplier

seed_ledger.name: Circe Energy Data Centers E. Monahans Campus (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Circe press and trade coverage (Cummins release of June 2026, Data Center Dynamics, Baxtel, mgrid) describe a 1,950-acre behind-the-meter campus with about 2 GW of Cummins generators, 150 MW in 2027 growing to 1.1 GW by 2030. None names a pipeline, supplier, tap or lateral. A TCEQ notice for Monahans (permit 178462, two turbines at 600 N Yucca Drive) is a different project and does not name Circe. Aterio shows 0 percent construction. EIA workbook, FERC, county records and midstream decks show nothing for this site. Searches run: 7. Sources: Data Center Dynamics (generator deal only), Cummins Business Wire release (equipment only), Baxtel and mgrid (same), Aterio (no supply), Cleanview Monahans Power Gas (18 MW, unrelated), TCEQ 178462 notice (different developer), Hart Energy Vaquero item (no Circe link).

evidence.note: Circe generator deal, behind the meter, no pipeline named
